company.name: Craniometrix
company.shortDescription: Better care for dementia patients. New revenue for their doctors.
company.description: Craniometrix, in partnership with the Johns Hopkins MIND at Home program, provides virtual, non-clinical support to dementia patients and their families. By leveraging Medicare's GUIDE program, we provide these services to patients at no cost -- and produce new revenue for their doctors in the process.

productsAndServices.description: A dementia care program enabling providers to enroll patients in Medicare's GUIDE model, offering care navigation and support services.
productsAndServices.name: Craniometrix GUIDE Program

productsAndServices.description: A software platform for providers and care navigators to collaborate and manage dementia care in compliance with GUIDE requirements.
productsAndServices.name: Care Central Application

productsAndServices.description: Digital assessments based on MIND at Home models to evaluate dementia patients' needs and inform care plans.
productsAndServices.name: Comprehensive Assessments

productsAndServices.description: Template-based care plans generated from assessment data to guide dementia patient care and updated as needed.
productsAndServices.name: Personalized Care Plans

productsAndServices.description: A live support line providing caregivers with access to dementia-trained specialists and assistance at any time.
productsAndServices.name: 24/7 Caregiver Support Hotline

productsAndServices.description: Services that coordinate referrals to specialists and manage transitions in dementia patient care among providers and caregivers.
productsAndServices.name: Care Coordination and Transitional Care Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $36,397,851 to $36,397,851, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 66 (+31 over 90 days) and market heat at 72 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Benjamin Rose Institute on Aging, CareMore Health, CenterWell Senior Primary Care.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
